Let \(a_7\) be the elf who answered 160, so \(a_6+a_8=160\). The odd-indexed equations are:
\[
a_1+a_3=110,\quad a_3+a_5=130,\quad a_5+a_7=150,\quad a_7+a_9=170,\quad a_9+a_1=190.
\]
Solving:
\[
a_3=110-a_1,\quad a_5=20+a_1,\quad a_7=130-a_1,\quad a_9=40+a_1.
\]
Then
\[
a_9+a_1=190 \implies (40+a_1)+a_1=190 \implies a_1=75.
\]
So
\[
a_7=130-75=55.
\]
\[
\boxed{55}
\]
